ns2:course.label: Membrane Separations Tech
ns2:course.description: (FSHN 460) Examines theory and applications of synthetic semipermeable membranes in reverse osmosis, ultrafiltration, microfiltration, and electrodialysis processes; thermodynamics of bioseparations, membrane chemistry and properties, process engineering, equipment design, fouling of membranes, selected applications. Offered alternate years. Prerequisite: FSHN 460 or consent of instructor.
